summary: Imperial Petroleum Inc., a Marshall Islands-incorporated, Athens-based shipowner listed on Nasdaq under IMPP, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated September 10, 2026, reporting unaudited second-quarter and six-month 2026 results. Q2 revenue was a record $87.1 million, operating income $33.4 million, net income $34.8 million, basic EPS $0.75, EBITDA $41.2 million, with cash and time deposits of $245.2 million. Fleet utilization was 73.5%; the company took delivery of dry bulk carriers Eco Crossfire and Outrider and sold tanker Suez Enchanted for a roughly $32 million net gain. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; the 6-K is an earnings release incorporation by reference into existing shelf registration statements.
